questions.question: What will this Helm command produce?
questions.correctOutput: YAML output of all Kubernetes resources that would be created, along with debug info
questions.correctAnswer: YAML output of all resources with debug information
questions.explanation: `--dry-run --debug` renders the templates and prints the manifests without applying them, plus debug logs.

questions.question: Given this Role and RoleBinding, what can the ServiceAccount 'reader' do?
questions.codeSnippet:
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: pod-reader
  namespace: default
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["pods"]
  verbs: ["get", "list"]
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: read-pods
  namespace: default
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: reader
  namespace: default
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: pod-reader
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
questions.correctOutput: Get and list Pods in the default namespace
questions.correctAnswer: Get and list Pods in the default namespace
questions.explanation: The Role allows get and list on pods, and the RoleBinding binds it to the 'reader' ServiceAccount in the same namespace.

questions.question: What will happen if you apply this SecurityContext?
questions.correctOutput: The Pod will fail to start because runAsNonRoot conflicts with root user (UID 0)
questions.correctAnswer: Pod creation fails due to conflicting settings
questions.explanation: runAsNonRoot=true requires the user not to be 0, but runAsUser sets 0. The API server will reject the Pod.

questions.question: What is the output of this Helm command?
questions.correctAnswer: The user‑supplied values (or null if none were overridden)
questions.explanation: `helm get values` shows the values that were passed during installation or upgrade. If no custom values, it prints `null` or an empty set.

questions.question: After running this command, what will the cluster state be?
questions.correctOutput: The release is upgraded to 5 replicas. If the upgrade fails, it's rolled back automatically.
questions.correctAnswer: The release is upgraded with 5 replicas; automatic rollback on failure
questions.explanation: `--atomic` ensures that if the upgrade fails, it rolls back to the previous successful version.

questions.question: What is the effect of this ClusterRole?
questions.codeSnippet:
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: node-viewer
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["nodes"]
  verbs: ["get", "list", "watch"]
questions.correctOutput: Allows reading (get, list, watch) of node resources across the entire cluster
questions.explanation: Nodes are cluster‑scoped, so a ClusterRole is needed. This role grants read‑only access to all nodes.
